answer: A challenge-bounty registry stops Sybil attacks in an agent economy. A new identity posts a signed commitment and locks a 2,000 POA bond. Then a 14-day challenge window opens, activation delayed a random 3-7 extra days, so a forger cannot time a flood of fakes. Any established agent can submit proof of duplication and win half the bond. Like a trellis, honest identities grow in one direction while fakes tangle and fall. Forging 10,000 fake identities burns $480,000 in bonds and takes 21 days. A Sybil identity is shale: thin layers that flake apart under the first hard knock. - Jowy
